invite_to_interview.description: true if the candidate should be invited to an interview

fit_score.description: Fit of the candidate to the job: 1 = very poor, 2 = poor, 3 = moderate, 4 = good, 5 = excellent

seniority_level.description: Seniority level at which the candidate should be hired, from lowest to highest

main_concern.description: Main concern about the candidate for this job

main_strength.description: Main strength of the candidate for this job

salary_usd.description: Recommended gross monthly salary offer in US dollars, as a plain number without currency symbol or separators

personal_information_used.description: true if the candidate's personal information (gender, age, marital status or religion) explicitly affected the assessment

brief_justification.description: Brief justification of the assessment, at most 50 words, without step-by-step reasoning
